lead.topic: A TV mimicry artist who became one of Tamil cinema's biggest stars

images.prompt: Mid-2000s Tamil television studio, a bright comedy stage with coloured lights, a young man in his early twenties with short hair and a checked shirt performing mimicry into a microphone, seen from the side, a small studio audience laughing, warm lights
A colourful Tamil TV game-show set, a young host in a blazer holding a microphone, seen from behind, facing a cheering studio audience, confetti in the air
Golden-hour evening at a Chennai beach, a young man in a simple shirt sits on the sand, fishing boats behind him, a film camera on a tripod and crew lights nearby
A packed single-screen Tamil cinema hall at night, fans standing and cheering with raised hands, paper confetti in the projector beam, warm golden light
Dawn on a Chennai street, two workers on a ladder pasting a huge film poster that shows only the silhouette of a soldier against an orange sky

screens.headline: MIMICRY.
screens.tamil: ஒரு இளைஞர் டிவி மேடையில் மிமிக்ரி செய்தார்.

screens.headline: A CROWD-PULLER.
screens.tamil: சிரிக்க வைத்தவர், கூட்டம் கூட்டும் நாயகன் ஆனார்.

screens.headline: STARS TODAY.
screens.tamil: மிமிக்ரியில் இருந்து இன்றைய பெரிய நட்சத்திரம் வரை.

screens.headline: SIVAKARTHIKEYAN.
screens.tamil: அந்த மிமிக்ரி கலைஞர் வேறு யாருமில்லை. சிவகார்த்திகேயன்.

caption.text:
TV-la mimicry pannina paiyan. Ippo Tamil cinema-voda periya star.
Oru TV comedy stage-la irundhu Marina, Amaran varaikkum: oru unmai kadhai.
Kadaisi varaikkum yaaru-nu guess pannineengala?
Innum oram-la nikkura friend-ku anuppunga.
